description: This file defines the IMediaPipelineClient interface, an abstract class that provides callback methods for media playback notifications such as duration, position, native size, network state, playback state, media data availability, QoS updates, and buffer underflow events. It is part of the Rialto media player API and is intended to be implemented by clients to receive media event notifications.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineClient
classes.description: Abstract base class for media pipeline client notifications, to be implemented by clients to handle media playback events.

methods.name: notifyDuration
methods.description: Notify client of total media duration in nanoseconds; uses special constants for unknown or live streams.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Notify client of current playback position in nanoseconds.

methods.name: notifyNativeSize
methods.description: Notify client of native video size and pixel aspect ratio.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Notify client of current network state.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Notify client of current playback state.

methods.name: notifyVideoData
methods.description: Notify client whether video data is available.

methods.name: notifyAudioData
methods.description: Notify client whether audio data is available.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notify client that media data is needed, with details for shared memory and frame count.

methods.name: notifyCancelNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notify client to cancel any outstanding media data request.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Notify client of QoS updates, such as dropped frames or samples.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Notify client that a buffer underflow has occurred.
